versions.subject: Merge PR #4463 from @citronninja - Add New Rules Related to VsCode Tunnel Usage & Abuse
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\code_tunnel.json'
filter_main_legit_name:
    # Note: There might be other legitimate names for VsCode. Please add them if found
    Image|endswith:
        - '\code-tunnel.exe'
        - '\code.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
